facts.Location: Primarily SF & NYC; can be based anywhere
facts.Focus: Founders, early operators, emerging AI-native crafts
facts.Funding / Support: No guaranteed capital; network, private dinners/retreats, hiring and fellowships
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: No published equity or fee for Build community
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: An application-based community for committed founders, prospective team members and emerging operators. The website explicitly states it is not an accelerator.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Strong career or project achievements, interest in a next company or collaborator, and relevance to SF or NYC founder networks.
facts.On-site Required: No / events concentrated in SF & NYC
facts.On-site / Attendance: Most gatherings are in SF or NYC, but members may live elsewhere. Fellowships typically last eight weeks, with some local dinner series.
facts.International Founder: Yes / location-flexible; participation value highest with US ecosystem access
facts.Visa / Relocation: No standard visa sponsorship or mandatory relocation.
facts.Application Materials: Community application; fellowship applications/interest lists separately.
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Founders and operators considering their next company or seeking cofounders, early hires or advisors, especially in AI-native ecosystems.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Founders seeking only cash, a formal curriculum or Demo Day, without a need for founder or talent networks.
facts.Notes: Primarily a founder and talent network. FDE, design, growth, talent and new-media fellowships are operator development programs, not capital programs.
